title: Create the runnable project and build ledger
interface: Establish working npm scripts typecheck, lint, test, build and later test:e2e; record real commands and runtime prerequisites. No placeholder scripts returning success.
steps: Inspect existing repo/runtime; scaffold Vite React/TypeScript only if no app exists. Keep dependency choices small, preserve unrelated files, and ignore secrets/build artifacts.
Add an app route, error boundary, environment validation with a useful not-configured screen, and one meaningful mount/configuration test. Add a fake-free local README.

Create state/checkpoint conventions and contracts for UUID IDs, Manila dates, structured command errors, expectedVersion and idempotencyKey. Document PostgreSQL as the authority and synthetic staging boundaries.
checks: Clean dependency install and actual typecheck/lint/test/build pass; an unavailable runtime is a recorded blocker, never a passing check.
App boots locally with no credentials without exposing secrets or pretending to load real work.
Repository has no committed secrets and state identifies P01 as next; application code only changes within this foundation.

title: Recreate the prototype navigation and visual shell
interface: Create reusable accessible page, panel, form/error and navigation patterns; expose role-filterable navigation without treating it as authorization.
steps: Inspect the supplied demo or its locally available source and preserve Karla, neutral palette, compact panels, interface accent and focus language; record tokens in DESIGN.md.

Implement desktop/sidebar and mobile labeled navigation, skip link, headings, keyboard focus, route-level loading/empty/error states. Use an approved logo asset if supplied; otherwise a plainly labeled temporary text identity.
Make synthetic preview content explicitly development-only; do not ship fake success buttons or recreate all feature pages now.
checks: Shell works at 320px width and 200% zoom with keyboard navigation and visible focus.
44px controls and meaningful accessible names survive long unit/person labels.
Route errors show a recovery action; production routes do not display synthetic metrics as real data.

title: Define members, terms, units and scoped roles
interface: organizations, terms, members, term_memberships, private_profiles, org_units, unit_memberships, roles, role_permissions and role_assignments. Actor linkage is server controlled.
steps: Initialize Supabase local configuration if absent, verify the target is local, and document Docker/CLI prerequisites. Add foundational identity/organization tables with real FKs, same-term checks, unique normalized identity, active/expired states, dated deployments and role assignments. Enable RLS/revoke exposed grants immediately; P03 adds permitted policies.
Keep committee delivery flags separate from service flags. MEAn affiliation is nullable descriptive data. Defer work-item scope FK until P07 rather than adding dangling references.
Seed clearly fictional local roles/members/units, not an invented official eight. Generate database types and document the identity contracts.
checks: Cross-term membership/unit links fail and duplicate normalized identities are rejected.
Changing MEAn affiliation creates no authorization change or new role assignment.
Fresh local migration/seed succeeds and all foundational tables have appropriate initial deny-by-default exposure.

title: Implement and test identity authorization boundaries
interface: Current-membership and effective-capability helpers derive auth.uid(); narrowly granted SQL functions use fixed search_path and no untrusted metadata.
steps: Enable RLS and minimal grants for identity/unit/role tables; separate permitted directory projection from private profiles. Add safe read helpers and role assignment restrictions.
Prevent member edits to auth linkage, grant scope, expiry, organization and private-profile visibility belonging to someone else. Treat project-owner bypass as documented infrastructure risk.
Create authenticated-principal fixtures for PM/head/member/associate/guest; add negative tests and a concise permission explanation contract. No UI or service-role-only proof.
checks: Same-domain nonmember, expired guest and suspended member read no workspace rows even with valid identity.
Equivalent MEAn/non-MEAn grants yield identical results; deployment grants only the configured unit.
Direct API attempts to self-grant roles or read another private profile fail; allowed writes assert the actual changed row.

title: Connect Google login and protected routes
files: src/features/auth/*; src/lib/supabase.ts; src/app/router.tsx; supabase/functions or auth hooks; docs/integrations.md
interface: Authenticated session resolves to an active member/term context; routes never infer organization access from email alone.
steps: Implement Supabase Google PKCE callback, exact redirect allowlist configuration, account switching/sign-out, and roster validation through trusted server/database logic.
Enforce exact student.ateneo.edu plus roster for ordinary core entry, not suffix tricks or hosted-domain hints. Reserve explicit guest path for P05.
Handle unavailable config, rejected school OAuth, expired sessions and safe post-login return routes. Document provider setup using secret references, not credentials in source.
checks: Approved school member enters; a different school student and lookalike domain do not.
Expired/suspended membership cannot bypass by opening a route or using an old token.
Real Google callback tested if credentials exist; otherwise local authorization tests pass and live OAuth verification is explicitly blocked, not claimed complete.

title: Add scoped off-domain guest invitations
interface: create_guest_invitation, redeem_guest_invitation, revoke_guest_access use hashed one-time tokens, verified identity, sponsor, exact record scopes and expiry.
steps: Implement invitation storage and server commands with exact verified-email binding, default 14-day access, single-use redemption and audit. Record-scoped targets attach once P07 exists.
Build sponsor admin form with clear scope preview, copy-link action, expiry/renew/revoke. External Google accounts work; no automatic email sending.
Ensure current DB checks revoke existing sessions' data access. Keep invitation model provider independent; do not add untested non-Google OTP.
checks: Forwarded token cannot be used by another email; double redemption and expired tokens fail.
Off-domain guest receives no full directory or membership-wide scope by default.
Revocation is enforced with a previously issued JWT, and no raw invite token is stored or logged.

title: Build the permitted member directory and process contacts
interface: Directory query returns safe name/unit/role/contact-route fields; private profile updates and visibility choices are separate commands.
steps: Build searchable basic people/unit/contact views, own profile editor and optional affiliation/skills/course/contact fields with clear sharing controls.
Make process contacts primary/backup and display plain descriptions rather than requiring acronyms. Use synthetic units until official roster arrives.
Keep guest directory limited to own/shared contacts; names in past records remain attributable without granting access to old private profiles.
checks: Head cannot change another member's optional disclosure or see unshared contact/course fields.
Affiliation left blank does not block tasks/onboarding or remove help links.
Multi-unit membership and missing backup contact render clearly on mobile without duplicate people.

title: Create common work records, grants, audit and safe commands
refs: Section 8 work items/audit; section 6 command contracts
interface: work_items, record_grants, status_definitions, audit_events, idempotency_keys and outbox_jobs; commands derive actor and enforce expected version.
steps: Create minimal common work-item spine and typed child creation convention with same-term integrity. Add record-scoped role/invite FKs deferred earlier.

Add RLS for ordinary summaries vs participant details and restricted classifications. Implement append-only redacted mutation audit and reusable idempotency/concurrency convention without a generic entity platform.
Provide transparent client command error mapping and generated types. Ensure direct status/owner/approval changes cannot bypass business commands.
checks: Read access to a child/grant does not leak unrelated parent/sibling or sensitive content.
Identical command retry returns its earlier result; changed payload under reused key fails.
Concurrent stale update fails cleanly; denied mutation creates no successful business/audit/outbox side effects.

title: Build the Core Deliverables list and detail view
interface: deliverables subtype and permission-filtered list/detail queries with owner, lead unit, date, readiness, next action and safe gate fields.
steps: Add deliverable child schema and real queries, including pagination/filter state and stable deep links. Seed one clearly synthetic shared-output example locally.
Implement required columns, phase/unit/owner/blocked/overdue/involves-my-unit filters, mobile rows, loading/error/empty states.
Use provisional pending-gate states until P29 installs authoritative acceptance; no client-generated approval badges or completion percentages masquerading as readiness.
checks: Restricted deliverables and private details are absent from unauthorized rows/counts.
Multi-unit filter uses one canonical output without duplicating it.
List/detail render real DB changes and provide a useful state for no records or denied deep links.

title: Add deliverable ownership, criteria and acceptance commands
interface: create_deliverable and update_deliverable require active owner, lead unit, outcome, date and criteria; acceptance evaluates server readiness.
steps: Build authorized create/edit/propose/reassign flows; preserve original deadline and reasoned changes. Members propose commitments for heads rather than assigning arbitrary people.
Implement draft/in-progress/submit-for-acceptance/accept/cancel with typed semantic states. Until P29, fail closed when unresolved mandatory gates exist.
Capture acceptance criteria revisions and final evidence; owner departure queues reassignment rather than silently becoming ownerless.
checks: Inactive/cross-term owner rejected; ordinary member cannot create a top-level event commitment directly.
Original deadline survives a later extension and change is attributed.
Direct API completion or acceptance with unmet criteria/gates fails; an authorized clean case succeeds.

title: Implement task creation, assignment and progress
interface: create_task, update_task, assign_task and transition_task; tasks relate to one canonical work item and optional deliverable/contribution.
steps: Implement My Tasks and task detail/editor with checklist, assignee, collaborators, dates, blocked reason and typed status categories.
Enforce own/unit/shared editing and prevent cross-unit assignment until accepted agreement exists. Preserve expected-version conflicts and original dates.
Treat Done as completion evidence/review appropriate to task type, never as authority to approve financial/publicity work.
checks: Duplicate retry creates one task; unauthorized assignee/owner changes fail.
Different committee cannot receive an imposed task before agreement/head acceptance.
Assignee can update allowed progress; overdue/date-only behavior is correct in Manila.

title: Add comments, history and eligible mentions
interface: add_comment and revise_comment preserve author/edit history; mention candidates come from eligible participants only.
steps: Build plain-text or safely sanitized Markdown comments shared by task/deliverable records. Show author, timestamps, edits and current permission state.
Retain original comment revisions referenced in submissions or decisions. Implement own draft removal and reasoned redaction rather than deleting evidence history.
Emit outbox mention events without sending external messages. Do not expose private directory candidates through autocomplete.
checks: Script/HTML payload does not execute; pasted unsafe links do not become executable content.
Unrelated user cannot enumerate comments, revisions or mention candidates.
Editing a decision-referenced comment preserves original evidence and shows later amendment.

title: Implement private uploads, Drive links and immutable manifests
interface: assets and asset_links with classification, hash, size and source; finalize_upload creates immutable manifest; downloads reauthorize and audit.
steps: Implement private PDF/JPEG/PNG uploads with proposed 5MB/file and 20MB/submission limits, content validation, random paths and safe download behavior.
Add validated Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides/Canva working links with access notes. A working URL is not approved evidence; support snapshot hashes/versions.
Inherit effective record access for file operations, prevent widening through extra links, and record restricted downloads without logging contents/tokens.
checks: Anonymous/other-unit/revoked user cannot download object via direct path or issue a signed URL.
MIME mismatch, executable/SVG/HTML/archive and oversize files are rejected.
Replacing a working source does not overwrite a finalized snapshot; hashes and manifest stay stable.

title: Build next actions and Who is waiting on you
interface: Authorized overview result separates actionable work from waiting-on-others and supports later request/handoff/approval sources.
steps: Aggregate real assigned due/overdue/blocked work and owned deliverables with next action/person/date. Integrate only sources already implemented, not invented pending approvals.
Add sensible empty/error/loading states, direct authorized links and committee context.
Define small source extensions so P18/P23/P30 add handoffs/reviews/inbox without duplicating counts or bypassing scopes.
checks: Widget count equals its visible actionable rows.
Restricted work does not leak through aggregate totals or hidden titles.
An action completed elsewhere disappears after real invalidation/refetch; no hardcoded demo numbers.

title: Implement versioned committee synergy agreements
interface: propose_synergy and respond_to_synergy support accept/decline/counterproposal against immutable agreement_revisions, creating named contributions on agreement.
steps: Model requester/receiver units, output, criteria, effort band, date, named owner and revision confirmations. Grant receiving heads only a safe proposal preview.
Require valid receiving-head authority and requester acceptance of counters. Accepted terms are immutable; material changes negotiate a revision.
Create canonical contribution/grants/tasks transactionally; no duplicate copies per committee and no implicit whole-parent access.
checks: Counterproposal does not activate work before requester confirms that revision.
Unrelated head or expired role cannot accept; unknown owner/cross-term links fail.
Concurrent accept/retry produces one contribution and one audit/outbox result.

title: Build Working Together and negotiation screens
interface: UI uses P14 commands and displays same agreement in requesting/receiving committee views with versioned accepted terms.
steps: Create outgoing/incoming agreements and contribution views, request-help form, accept/decline/counterproposal actions and clear pending ownership.
Add deliverable contributions panel and assigned work links; integrate accepted contributions in My Tasks/Overview.
Display proposed versus agreed deadlines and immutable history. Preserve mobile/keyboard usability.
checks: Two scoped users see one agreement with correct actions rather than duplicated independent records.
Receiver cannot edit other contributions/finance data through shared parent links.
A failed/stale negotiation keeps entered safe data and offers refresh without fake success.
